commonAttemptFields: Reference the shared submission/explanation contract for version, exact legacy/native outcome, stage/code, original/matching/native/current revisions, core reached and clock suspension. Do not duplicate or replace these keys. Common metadata alone grants no physical fact disclosure.

types.Identity: String restricted to existing valid public identity; empty native optional identity becomes explicit absent only after disclosure succeeds; never expose raw fingerprint/command payload.
types.Integer32: System.Int32 signed, for native grid coordinates/hand counts only if explicitly registered.
types.Integer64:hit-point: System.Int64 signed, native HP/potential/actual values; HP difference may be negative.
types.Code:<enum>: Allowlisted enum name, native enum backed by Int32; no unregistered diagnostic string or arbitrary object.
types.Time: Original normalized RuleTime with Int64 numerator and positive Int64 denominator; unit second; optional suffix ? retains absence.
types.Quantity:ration-pound: RuleQuantity Int64 numerator/positive Int64 denominator, unit TEST_ONLY.ration-pound.
types.Quantity:native-lot-unit: RuleQuantity Int64/Int64 and exact current/native source lot.UnitId. Only already admitted public unit IDs; retain prototype.potable-water.pint, TEST_ONLY.ration-pound or registered count/material unit; no implicit conversion.
types.Quantity:native-supply-unit: Exact reservation RuleQuantity and its actual supply ResourceLot.UnitId; never equate to ration pounds or abstract currency.
types.Quantity:owned-item-unit: Exact RuleQuantity Int64/Int64; linked InventoryLot uses native ResourceLot.UnitId; AlchemyDose uses item-count (the existing native one-or-zero quantity); no value/unit when legacy Available is absent.
types.Code:PortablePublicPlacement: Allowlisted exact strings of PortablePlacement (native Int32 enum) plus existing Club Held/Ground view labels; preserve string labels without pretending Held is a PortablePlacement value.

availabilityRules: All keys in the selected publicly known operation/variant registry have fixed order and shape, whether records exist or are hidden. Evaluate predicate before revealing applicability, record existence, record count, cause, optional absence or value. Failed predicate => Withheld with no value/causes.

Every N_ predicate is UNAPPROVED_NARROW_DISCLOSURE_PROPOSAL. Until actual review approves it, affected details stay Withheld; Retained metadata in this document describes native retention, not approved access.
Authorized absence or genuinely irrelevant fields => NotApplicable; a historical field not natively stored => NotRetained. Never use NotRetained to conceal an unresolved disclosure proposal.

Fresh rejected attempt contains no committed operation facts; common actual safe failure remains Immediate. Duplicate creates no new payment/time/healing and uses historical original facts or explicitly current observations.

Current fields on fresh submission are the actual post-attempt observation; retained earlier-job fields cannot be relabelled as this attempt's new effects. On interrupt/continuation operations, original start fields still reference their original job receipt.
ProjectionUnavailable remains truthful fault containment after outcome capture. It neither changes authoritative outcome nor closes missing required fields.
Null values and safe unavailable facts must not expose hidden target existence; no arbitrary effect/claim/body arrays or count fields are proposed.

A.definition: Exact current enabled seat/trusted route, exact principal, actor and native inventory-owner claims before exact receipt match. Existing narrow transaction exceptions only. Not target visibility.

O.definition: A plus actual enabled Player seat own actor projection, current grant.Controls(subject), and subject returned by ExpeditionOwnActor route. Operator ClockGrant and observer-only visible opponent do not qualify.

P_ITEM.definition: A plus the exact current ProjectItems branch for the item: MayUseInventory(actual owner) AND controlled actual custodian; plain lot must satisfy same inventory-owner/controlled lot-custodian branch, no selected-cache/trap exclusion bypass. Linked dose uses its existing portable branch. ProjectItems can show stowed items; this is not permission to use them as held.

P_DOSE_ITEM.definition: A plus actual dose currently representable by the existing ProjectItems branch. Unlinked spent doses are not newly revealed; linked selected spent vial can show quantity zero. No current-custody inference of ownership.

P_CACHE.definition: A + enabled Player View + actual ReachableCache: selected Hero-owned cache, nonburied, native NearCache, no Hero traversal and exact combat/profile condition. Fixed current cache fields only.

P_CACHE_STOCK.definition: P_CACHE plus actual open cache, retained stock in selected cache, Hero custody, Hero inventory ownership and Ground access. Preserve existing no-stock null/empty convention; no private unopened stock disclosure.

P_TRAP_REMOTE.definition: A + enabled Player route + grant.Controls(Companion) + grant.MayUseInventory(Companion) + actual selected trap. Only selected/latest own setup timing, restricted setup status and retrieval work/status already shown remotely.

P_TRAP_LOCAL.definition: P_TRAP_REMOTE + CanObserveTrap: outside combat, Companion stationary, aware, not sight-blocked, native FishingAccessFrom actual trap location. Only actual current physical status/check outcome/captured identity; never hidden opportunity or candidate-body data.

P_INTAKE_JOB.definition: A + enabled Player work projection + actual current grant.Controls(job.ActorId), returning only existing job Id/actor/kind/status. Does not authorize lot or reservation details.

N_CACHE_HISTORY.base: P_CACHE + O(Hero) + exact principal receipt/job binding
N_CACHE_HISTORY.reason: Native attempt method/start/end/status exists; existing cache view shows only current active pick, not historical attempts. Propose bounded facts for the exact requested own attempt while cache is currently reachable; no list, dice/modifier/DC/equipment secrets.

N_TRAP_HISTORY.base: P_TRAP_REMOTE + exact own set/retrieval receipt + fixed selected trap and authorized receiver identity
N_TRAP_HISTORY.reason: Extend remote own work bookkeeping only; terminal retrieval time/identity is not currently a public field. Does not reveal catch outcome/body.

N_TRAP_HISTORY_LOCAL.reason: Historical check terminal time/outcome only while actual local observation is allowed. No hidden eligibility/DC, opportunity identity, allocation, candidate species or body count.

N_PORTABLE_HISTORY.base: A + P_ITEM for actual current subject item + exact PortableHandlingRecord.Revision/actor/item match
N_PORTABLE_HISTORY.reason: Existing item view exposes current placement/owner/open/amount, not before/after history. Propose only exact requested handling event fields; current revocation hides history even after original ownership.

N_PORTABLE_PARENT_HISTORY.base: N_PORTABLE_HISTORY + P_ITEM independently for every nonempty referenced parent
N_PORTABLE_PARENT_HISTORY.reason: An own item's historic parent does not authorize identifying a now-hidden container.

N_PORTABLE_RECIPIENT_HISTORY.base: N_PORTABLE_HISTORY + O for nonempty recipient, or exact existing permitted public participant observation if explicitly adopted
N_PORTABLE_RECIPIENT_HISTORY.reason: Actor control does not reveal a foreign historical recipient. Current module proposes own-party O only; any visible-opponent extension requires its exact V rule.

N_INVENTORY_HISTORY.base: A + P_ITEM for exact child lot + native owner claims for exact requested source + immutable child provenance/receipt join
N_INVENTORY_HISTORY.reason: New original portion/handling quantity/provenance fields are retained but not all exposed by ProjectItems. Source must remain visible where identified; no hidden stock totals.

N_INVENTORY_PARENT_HISTORY.base: N_INVENTORY_HISTORY + P_ITEM(source) OR exact P_CACHE_STOCK for selected cache source
N_INVENTORY_PARENT_HISTORY.reason: Allow exact acquired cache portion parent only while present cache stock disclosure authorizes that identity; otherwise parent field Withheld independently.

N_VESSEL_CURRENT.base: A + actual WaterVesselRecord owner MayUseInventory + controlled actual CustodianId + currently known selected host vessel (Session KnownTarget) or P_ITEM on its linked portable item
N_VESSEL_CURRENT.reason: Legacy ProjectItems has no universal standalone vessel detail DTO. Propose current owner/custody only; no invented flask Open state. Exact vessel/source-owner claim checks remain required.

N_VESSEL_HISTORY.reason: Retained movement history is not existing public view. It cannot grant rights to the contents.

N_VESSEL_LOCATION_HISTORY.base: N_VESSEL_HISTORY + each nonactor location currently known through exact host target/current public location rule
N_VESSEL_LOCATION_HISTORY.reason: Do not expose hidden containers/cache/source locations through a historic move. Unknown location field independently Withheld.

N_VESSEL_PARTICIPANT_HISTORY.base: N_VESSEL_HISTORY + O for each nonempty custody participant
N_VESSEL_PARTICIPANT_HISTORY.reason: Proposed bounded own-party custody history; no generalized visible-observer entitlement.

N_INTAKE_DETAILS.base: P_INTAKE_JOB + P_ITEM for actual lot + exact claim JobId/LotId/reservation binding
N_INTAKE_DETAILS.reason: Existing work view exposes status, not current consumed/released amounts or original reservation facts. No other jobs/claims enumerated.

N_DOSE_USE.base: A + P_DOSE_ITEM/current actual dose owner and custody authority + unique committed use receipt + O(user)
N_DOSE_USE.reason: Retained use history is not public solely because dose quantity is visible. No stowed-to-held eligibility inference and no restoration of revoked inventory access.

N_DOSE_HEALING.reason: Own-recipient actual healing history is source-retained and complements current HP observation; control of item/user alone does not reveal recipient HP. No raw dice/RNG.

N_PROTECTION_HISTORY.base: A + P_ITEM(current exact vessel) + N_TREATMENT for the exact linked treatment/lot + exact evidence command/revision/portable-handling link
N_PROTECTION_HISTORY.reason: Preservation evidence has no current host DTO predicate. Propose only exact selected specimen/vessel controlled-opening event, not hidden exposure history or clean-tool source ledger.

N_TREATMENT.base: A + enabled Player + O(Companion worker) + selected connected BloodSpecimen + exact KnownTarget StartHarvestPreservationTreatment + current MayUseInventory of actual specimen owner + controlled actual specimen custody + authorized known actual bound vessel
N_TREATMENT.reason: No existing connected treatment-result view. Proposed local own selected treatment facts, anchored to native selected specimen/worker/source binding; do not adopt arbitrary fixture treatment or foreign harvest records. Current lot/vessel knowledge must use actual ProjectItems or exact selected host-authorized specimen/vessel route, never Controls alone.

N_TREATMENT_TOOL.base: N_TREATMENT + current inventory/structure owner access and selected source binding of exact tool
N_TREATMENT_TOOL.reason: Do not expose CleanToolFactId or unobserved owned tools merely from treatment history.

N_TREATMENT_SUPPLY.base: N_TREATMENT + current MayUseInventory(actual SupplyLot owner) + exact controlled custody/native accessible selected stock + exact SupplyReservationId
N_TREATMENT_SUPPLY.reason: Fixed supply role only, no reservation list or hidden stock count.

N_PROTECTION_CURRENT.base: A + P_ITEM for exact current container + N_TREATMENT for actual linked treated lot and vessel; exact native current coverage query only
N_PROTECTION_CURRENT.reason: Existing item Open does not disclose preservation eligibility. New bounded own treated-lot coverage field requires approval; no inferred age reset, hidden exposure count or forecast.

receiptJoins.J_REQUEST: A matches exact bound-principal receipt and exact command internally (or current attempted command for fresh submission); caller text alone never establishes authoritative target existence.
receiptJoins.J_ATTEMPT: The one actual authoritative invocation's captured pre/post snapshots under session gate and exact native result. Rejected rolled-back candidate changes excluded; no replay or assessment recomputation.
receiptJoins.J_PORTABLE: PortableHandlingRecord.Revision equals receipt.Revision; actor/item and operation match exact command semantics; native Id is inventory.<revision>.portable. Original command is also resolving command; fields record actual post-time result. Club-pickup special route uses same explicit revision record.
receiptJoins.J_CACHE: Pick attempt Id=inventory.<originRevision>.cache-attempt via OrdinaryInventory.Identity; check exact receipt kind Interact, target CacheId, PickWithTools, actor and principal. Open branch has no independent open event; original receipt plus actual immediate observation only.
receiptJoins.J_CACHE_TERMINAL: Retain J_CACHE. Native EndedAt/status/check facts have no explicit terminal CommandId/Revision. For an actual current interruption/completion carrier identify its true resolving command immediately; later explanation must not infer it from time/actor. Resolving receipt availability NotRetained where no separate explicit source exists.
receiptJoins.J_TRAP: FishingTrapAttemptRecord.Id=fishing.trap.<setReceiptRevision>; exact Interact Set/selected trap/Companion/principal. Existing remote current view selects latest own attempt; historical requested earlier attempt requires N_ predicate, not reuse of latest view.
receiptJoins.J_TRAP_TERMINAL: J_TRAP plus actual attempt's immutable terminal fields; no stored check-resolving receipt revision. Keep original set cause, later resolver identity NotRetained unless captured in actual submission.
receiptJoins.J_TRAP_RETRIEVAL: FishingTrapRetrievalRecord.Id=fishing.trap.retrieval.<retrieveReceiptRevision>; exact Interact Retrieve actor/trap/destination; AttemptId links original set and fixed physical trap. Pause/Resume target current retrieval via native linkage, not invented new set receipt.
receiptJoins.J_TRAP_RETRIEVAL_TERMINAL: J_TRAP_RETRIEVAL; CompletedAt retained, no explicit later resolver receipt. Do not use timestamp uniqueness as causal authentication.
receiptJoins.J_CHILD: For PortionInventory or HandleInventory, actual child LotId=inventory.<receipt.Revision>.lot plus exact ParentId==command.Target and CreatedAmount==actual requested committed amount; validated native lineage. Require relevant native lot unit, not caller's invented unit.
receiptJoins.J_HANDLING: HandlingRecord.Id=inventory.<receipt.Revision>.handling; ActorId/SourceId/ChildId/Kind must match exact committed command and J_CHILD. Record has no independent revision property; use canonical native identity relation.
receiptJoins.J_VESSEL: VesselHandlingRecord.Sequence==receipt.Revision and Id=inventory.<revision>.vessel-move; exact actor/vessel/kind and native destination binding. Retained same-attempt before/after custody/location, no content ownership transfer implied.
receiptJoins.J_INTAKE: IntakeRecord.Id=inventory.<startReceiptRevision>.intake, exact original StartIntake actor/lot/principal. InterruptIntake command.Target must equal that actual Id. No current working-status inference of original eligibility.
receiptJoins.J_INTAKE_CLAIM: J_INTAKE plus ReservationId==job.Id+'.stock', ResourceReservation.JobId==job.Id and LotId==job.LotId. Amount original, consumed/released/remaining current totals.
receiptJoins.J_INTAKE_TERMINAL: J_INTAKE. For explicit requested InterruptIntake the unique validated command targeting job proves that requested interrupt, with immediate result captured; automatic completion/interruption has no retained terminal revision on IntakeRecord. Do not manufacture a clock cause from EndedAt.
receiptJoins.J_DOSE: Exact committed UseAlchemyDose receipt, target dose.Id, actor==dose.UserId and exact native recipient selection matches dose.RecipientId; require unique once-only use receipt for this dose and native spent record. UsedAt is not a revision and does not authenticate a different nearby command. Native CommandHistory parsing for internal match is not replay and is never exported.
receiptJoins.J_TREATMENT: Attempt.Id=harvest.preservation.<startReceiptRevision>; exact StartHarvestPreservationTreatment command actor/target/amount and bound container/tool/supply from selected fixture. Separate from manufacturing order stabilization.
receiptJoins.J_TREATMENT_TERMINAL: J_TREATMENT plus immutable CompletedAt/SealedAt/check degree. Record has no explicit resolving revision; later resolver receipt unavailable without actual immediate carrier or another retained explicit causal record.
receiptJoins.J_TREATMENT_CLAIMS: J_TREATMENT plus exact TargetReservationId/SupplyReservationId, JobId and respective LotId; project fixed two role fields only.
receiptJoins.J_OPENING: HarvestPreservationEvidenceRecord.CommandId==exact command.Id, AppliedRevision==receipt.Revision; Kind ControlledOpening; PortableHandlingId matches J_PORTABLE and VesselId/treatment link match actual selected open. Do not match only time or vessel.
receiptJoins.J_PROTECTION_CURRENT: Exact currently authorized container/item and actual native treatment InventoryLotId/ContainerId linkage; current IsProtectedAt projection belongs to current observation, not an alleged original opening/closing effect. No requirement that the requested Close receipt itself be a ControlledOpening event.

acceptanceLimits: This is a source-bound proposal. N_ predicates need actual review, every required result field needs a concrete approved disclosure test, and all causal join/retention limitations must be retained. No runtime execution or full API/module acceptance is claimed.

gpt03Alignment.futureConditionalObligations: Separate typed description/assessment descriptors; never actual facts. None of the keys predicts future completion, dice, payment or source settlement.
gpt03Alignment.currentAvailability: ObservedCurrent appears only with CurrentObservation/CurrentContinuation; fresh post-attempt capture is Immediate/AttemptInterval.
gpt03Alignment.rollback: Only actual committed captured before/after state and retained native events supply paid-time/quantity facts. Candidate time/action effects rolled back after a later check are not reported. Partial committed and suspended outcomes remain distinct.
gpt03Alignment.capacity: A deterministic capacity constraint may be described by initialEligibility/commitFeasibility/nativeEnforcementStage on the assessment descriptor, never by pretending a native failure already occurred. This result registry introduces no reordered check or predicted denial.

protectedShape.ordering: Each public operation/known variant always returns the complete fixed ordered applicable registry key set. Gating occurs before record lookup reveals value, existence, optional absence, cause or count.
protectedShape.keysForUnknownVariant: Use safe common attempt fields only; never select a hidden authoritative record family merely because caller target text resembles it.
protectedShape.arrays: No public arrays of records, hidden bodies, sources, claims or effects. Each role is a fixed field; only individually authorized causal references.
protectedShape.unapprovedPredicates: Withheld until approved, even if native source retention is certain.

sourceEvidenceLimit: All new historical or richer current disclosures use explicitly named N_ proposals until actual approval; P_ predicates only reuse fields already exposed by their exact existing view. No historical witness, result field or namespace is deemed approved by a type/key registration alone.
verification: Unique keys; every predicate/join/group reference resolves; all 13 operation names/order equal independent source audit; ObservedCurrent temporal labels restricted; all source pins exact baseline. Static checks only, no runtime execution.
